summary: Explore effective social protection systems in low-income countries through our comprehensive training program. Empower communities and drive sustainable change
lede: Social protection systems training covers how to assess gaps and plan support when budgets, records, and delivery channels are constrained. It is for practitioners involved in programme design, financing, administration, or oversight who need practical ways to improve delivery. Learners develop skills in targeting and vulnerability assessment, simplified programme costing, delivery workflow mapping, and monitoring dashboard design.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work on the design, financing, administration, or oversight of social protection systems and need practical tools they can apply immediately.
outcomes: Programme Costing And Fiscal Space Analysis
modules: Social Protection Floors and System Basics
prerequisites: You should have a role in social protection, public policy, development programming, M&E, or public finance. A basic ability to interpret spreadsheets and programme documents is useful, and prior exposure to registry systems, transfer programmes, or poverty targeting will help you move faster. Bring a laptop, a calculator or spreadsheet tool, and access to sample programme or administrative data if available.
